contentText:
Matt Bolton / TechRadar :

Apple announces that AirPods will gain a custom EQ feature as part of iOS 27   —  We've only been waiting 10 years  —  Apple just announced that one of the longest-requested features from AirPods users is finally coming as part of iOS 27: a custom EQ.  Announced during the WWDC 2026 keynote …
